name: cascade-web
description: Test tooling for cascade-web, plus the Capacitor iOS wrapper (CAS-453). The web app itself still ships as one built index.html with no build step; it does poll movies.json at runtime (CAS-488) to keep an open tab's catalogue live, with the build-time copy baked in as the offline/first-paint fallback.
